name: xharness
description: Local script aliases for dotnet/xharness (optional; repo is .NET-first).

scripts.harness: node scripts/check-encapsulation.mjs && dotnet build XHarness.slnx && dotnet test XHarness.slnx --no-build
scripts.harness:ci: node scripts/check-encapsulation.mjs && dotnet restore XHarness.slnx && dotnet build XHarness.slnx && dotnet test XHarness.slnx --no-build
scripts.harness:full: node scripts/check-encapsulation.mjs && dotnet restore XHarness.slnx && dotnet build XHarness.slnx -c Debug && dotnet test XHarness.slnx -c Debug --no-build && dotnet build XHarness.slnx -c Release && dotnet test XHarness.slnx -c Release --no-build
